lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li6H2O2 (reduced formula Li3HO) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li centers with three O neighbors (2.16–2.18 Å), H centers with a single O neighbor, and O centers with four Li neighbors (2.16–2.18 Å). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Li-centered 3-vertex and O-centered 4-vertex coordination polyhedra.
